# Homebrew Ocean

<!-- Generated by tools/theme-readme-gen.py from scheme.toml; do not edit. -->

Terminal-inspired colors for GNOME (GTK 3, GTK 4 and libadwaita, GNOME Shell) and for terminals and command-line tools. Variants: dark only.

![Homebrew Ocean dark palette](palette-dark.svg)

- Colors: Homebrew Ocean (colours of the Ptyxis built-in 'Homebrew Ocean'; origin named in the built-in's header: https://github.com/Gogh-Co/Gogh/tree/master/themes/Homebrew%20Ocean.yml).
- Default accent: cyan (#00A6B2); the other accents are listed by `switch-theme`.
- Ptyxis uses its built-in palette `Homebrew Ocean`.

## Install and use

```
ujust gnome-candy install-theme homebrew-ocean
ujust gnome-candy switch-theme homebrew-ocean
```

Without the image recipe, run `just install-theme homebrew-ocean` and `just switch-theme homebrew-ocean` in a checkout of [candy-for-gnome](https://github.com/redcodeworks/candy-for-gnome).

## License

The generated GTK and Shell files in `gtk/` derive from the stock GTK and GNOME Shell stylesheets and stay under the LGPL (each folder there has its `LICENSE`). The tooling and this page are MIT; the color credits are in the repository `NOTICE`.
